description: Bâtiment 3D 2013 (Maquette CityGML LOD2 avec textures) (archives) is a dataset listed in City of Montréal open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Montréal. Maquette numérique des bâtiments 3D LOD2 avec textures en format CityGML et 3DM de certains arrondissements de Montréal. Le modèle numérique du terrain (MNT) de ces arrondissements est également disponible pour présenter la maquette numérique complète du territoire. Coverage: Montréal. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Montréal. Its tags are 3D, Bâtiment, Maquette, SIRR, Élévation. It offers 58 resource(s) in 3DM, DXF, GML. The portal shows 2025-02-24 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-montreal-portal.
